messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming tail latency breach detected in eu-west-1. p95=780ms, p99=2.8s over the last 5m against the streaming gateway. Potential SSE/WebSocket chunk stalls and increased proxy timeouts. Auto-page sent to #incidents and rotation.

oliver: I'm on it. grabbing traces now — switching Slack thread to live.

maria: seeing elevation in client backlog counters on proxy pool-12, connections in CLOSE_WAIT stacking. suspect downstream flush/backpressure.

sree: @oliver @maria can you confirm whether this correlates with the midnight traffic surge? Any recent deploys?

oliver: no deploys in last hour. Observability shows a spike in long-lived streams with repeated small chunks. chunk rate dropped -> increased per-connection buffering.

aviv: logs from edge-proxy-12: 
```
W 2026-03-15T02:10:12Z proxy: write timeout after 30s -> conn=34567 route=/v1/stream \nW 2026-03-15T02:10:12Z proxy: client_write_backpressure high (rbuf=512kb)\n```

tara: noticed that several clients are not honoring exponential backoff; they're retrying aggressively which piles up server queues. possible slow consumers.

maria: customer impact: about 120k requests in 5m impacted, 0.8% of total streaming sessions. two enterprise customers reported slow streaming in EU. marking P2 for now unless customer complaints escalate.

ops-rotation: @oliver takeover? rotation shift started, please confirm primary and secondary.

oliver: I'm primary. @maria secondary. tagging inc-ops for visibility.

sree: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase proxy keepalive and write_timeout to 60s, 2) enable aggressive per-connection chunk flushing in runtime (force small buffer flush), 3) route traffic to fallback non-streaming endpoint for heavy clients, 4) throttle repeat offenders at ALB.

aviv: +1 on increasing write_timeout now to reduce 502s from abrupt socket closes. making a config change in staging first.

tara: we should avoid increasing timeouts for long — it masks the root. recommend adding immediate client-side guidance and a short-term throttle for identified IPs.

omcall-bot: NOTE: running quick runbook checks -> streaming-p95-checks, proxy-backlog-checks, client-heap-checks.

maria: I'm running a live query to list top 50 client IPs by open streams and backlog size. will post results in 2m.

(2m later)
maria: top offenders show repeated ~30-40 concurrent streams from handful of IP blocks (ASN 54000). one client sends tiny deltas every 1-2s which causes many small chunks.

oliver: applying immediate ACL rule to rate-limit new streaming sessions from those IP ranges (30s window). rolling to edge-proxy cluster.

aviv: config change deployed to edge-proxy pool eu-west-1 behind a feature flag: increased write_timeout=60s, write_buffer_flush=on. Monitoring latency effects.

sree: also toggle "force_chunk_coalesce=false" on runtime for a few minutes to reduce buffering delays. ready to flip if oliver agrees.

oliver: flip it. doing runtime change on canary nodes first.

(5m after mitigations)
maria: metrics: p95 down to 420ms, p99 down to 1.1s. client backlog reduced by ~70%. enterprise customers reporting partial recovery.

tara: pushing a short status note to affected customers via support channel. include recommended client backoff config and suggest connection retry jitter.

incident-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-0315-04. Initial severity P2. Actions logged: proxy ACL, timeout bump, runtime flush toggle.

oliver: next steps: 1) keep throttles for 30m, 2) run deeper heap/conn analysis on proxy nodes, 3) contact AS 54000 account owners to advise on client behavior, 4) prepare rollback plan.

maria: I'll capture HARs and wire traces for one affected session and attach to the incident.

sree: pls add a follow-up eval to Redwood Optimize to detect repeated small-chunk patterns and suggest auto-coalescing rules.

aviv: scheduled a follow-up window in 45m to revert write_timeout and flush flags if stable.

oliver: handing incident to @maria for overnight follow-up. I remain available for questions. shifting status to monitoring. :white_check_mark:

maria: acknowledging takeover. will run the postmortem template and collect timelines. adding customer-impact notes and action items.

oncall-bot: Reminder: on-call rotation handoff in 25m. @ops-rotation please ensure any outstanding ACL flags are durable across restarts.

maria: noted. saving ACLs to infra repo and creating a change with short TTL. tagging infra for review.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: MONITORING -> RESOLVED at 2951230450. Final metrics: p95 steady at 380ms, p99 at 0.95s. No data loss. Postmortem required due to SLO breach at p99.

oliver: closing thread. thanks everyone. :pray:
